_comment: Mutation coverage ratchet (#75, #79). Raise it by proving more checks. Lowering it — including by deleting checks — is a deliberate act that belongs in a commit message, not a side effect.
checks: asdd_state.py runs no git or gh
change-discipline is in the activation table and the PR checklist
changed scripts and contracts are recorded in the changelog
compatibility claims match what the last release published
constitution and CLAUDE.md reference the floor, not a bare number
constitution has articles I–IX and a version line
data-quality rules over the corpus's own datasets
documented agent commands use python3, not bare python
every named check has a failing path
live feature specs address their abuse surface
no unqualified speedup ratio is published
only vcs.sh creates a branch, and only behind the protected-name guard
open items carry a date or a named trigger
settings.json keeps the PreToolUse high-risk guard
spec evidence paths resolve or carry an explicit marker
tasks-template keeps tests-first and mandatory tests
the corpus carries at least one measurement of itself
the measurement is scheduled, not merely described
the measurement report is structurally current
throttled responses name the caller's budget
vcs.sh refuses merge, release, deploy, push and protected branches
